jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**Join our expanding engineering team! We're actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale M\-KOPA Mobility, our fast\-growing e\-mobility business.** **This is an initial 12\-month Fixed Term Contract, with the potential to extend or transition into a permanent role. Build the event\-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa.**

**The Impact** – Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya's leading e\-mobility financing platform. We've already financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It's your chance to build tech for a business that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**


**Mission\-driven engineering:** Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who'd otherwise be locked out of ownership


**Global recognition:** Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest\-growing companies for 5 consecutive years running (2022–2026\)


**Scale challenges:** Build backend systems for a business growing at 3x year\-on\-year, with over 11,000 e\-motorbikes financed and demand climbing


**Real climate impact:** Electric is simply better for drivers, cities, and the planet — our e\-motorbikes cut air pollution by 90% versus petrol equivalents

**What You'll Do**


At M\-KOPA, you'll build sophisticated event\-driven microservices with real\-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end\-to\-end – from architecture decisions to production monitoring. Join us in combining cutting\-edge .NET development with purpose\-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa.

**Technical Environment**

* **Languages \& frameworks:** C\#/.NET
* **Cloud:** We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP
* **Architecture:** Event\-driven systems and microservice development – we use Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
* **Infrastructure:** Kubernetes, Docker
* **Observability:** Prometheus, Grafana
* **Engineering culture:** DevOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing across all environments including production, continuous delivery
* **AI tooling:** We use AI coding tools including Claude Code as part of our engineering workflow

**Our Engineering Approach**

As an engineer, you will work as a collaborator. More senior members will coach and contribute, placing an emphasis on:

* High quality output
* Observability and monitoring
* Automated testing in all environments, including production
* Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices

**What You Need**


We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first\-order concerns in development.


Required Experience:

* Strong grasp of C\# .NET development
* Experience with event\-driven systems – Service Bus or similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
* Microservices architecture experience
* Experience with Azure, or other major cloud providers such as AWS or GCP
* Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker)
* Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
* Testing and deployment expertise
* DevOps culture mindset
* Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar

**Location \& Benefits**

* Initial 12\-month Fixed Term Contract, with potential to extend or transition into a permanent role
* Fully remote role within UTC \-1 to UTC \+3 time zones
* Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa
* Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and career growth opportunities

**Our Mission** We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model, with M\-KOPA Mobility extending that same model to clean transport. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**

* **Connected :** 6 million smartphone customers, 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users
* **Prosperous :** 70% of customers use their M\-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000\+ livelihoods created for agents
* **Green :** 11,000\+ e\-motorbikes financed, growing 3x year\-on\-year, cutting air pollution by 90% and helping riders save more than $3 a day

**Ready to build C\# .NET solutions that put clean, affordable transport within reach of Every Day Earners, while advancing your career in modern backend engineering?**

**At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritise well\-being, and embrace flexibility.**

**Apply now to join our mission of transforming lives across Africa through technology.**

**Why M\-KOPA?**
----------------


At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

*Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026\), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 \& 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e\-bikes financed in Kenya.*

***Important Notice***  

  

*M\-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*M\-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M\-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.*

*M\-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre\-employment or post\-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.*

*Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.*

*If your application is successful M\-KOPA undertakes pre\-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.*

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 28 September 2026**Job Description**

  



**Title** AI Solutions Engineer

**Department** Asset Management Platforms

**Location**Dublin

**Reports To**Head of Portfolio Management Tooling, AMP

**Level** 6


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.


Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.


As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability\-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**


Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Investment Management, Asset Management Operations and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enable investment professionals to make better investment decisions and improve client outcomes.


The Portfolio Management Tooling team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used by Portfolio Managers, Investment Directors, Quantitative Researchers and Investment Specialists across multiple investment capabilities, including Multi\-Asset, Systematic Investing, Fixed Income and Equities. Our platforms underpin critical investment processes including research, portfolio construction, analytics, order generation, execution management and investment risk.


As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI\-assisted development with robust engineering disciplines to improve productivity, quality and speed of delivery. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in helping engineering teams adopt AI\-enabled development practices safely, effectively and responsibly across Asset Management Platforms.

**About your role**  

The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands\-on technical leader responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.


Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI\-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.


You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI\-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI\-assisted software engineering. This includes enabling engineering teams to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.


The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will champion modern software engineering practices, support architectural decision\-making, promote CI/CD and DevSecOps adoption, and help establish governance frameworks for the responsible use of AI within the software development lifecycle.


This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high\-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted software engineering practices across Asset Management Platforms.
* Evaluate emerging AI development tools and recommend practical use cases for engineering teams.
* Champion the effective use of Large Language Models to improve developer productivity and software quality.
* Develop reusable prompts, workflows, templates and engineering patterns for AI\-assisted software development.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI\-assisted development tools.
* Identify opportunities where AI can automate engineering activities including documentation, code generation, testing, code review, refactoring and technical analysis.
* Help establish engineering standards and governance for AI\-generated code.

**Software Engineering**

* Design and develop modern software solutions supporting Fidelity's investment management platforms.
* Promote engineering best practices across software design, development, testing and maintainability.
* Support engineering teams with complex technical design and implementation challenges.
* Encourage clean architecture, modular design and reusable software components.
* Participate in code reviews and engineering quality initiatives.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering standards and practices.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Improve engineering productivity through automation and tooling.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote test automation and engineering quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Support engineering governance while encouraging innovation and experimentation.

**Architecture \& Governance**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI\-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Contribute to engineering roadmaps and technology strategy.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI\-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI\-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge\-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

**About you**


You are a hands\-on engineer with strong technical aptitude, curiosity and a passion for using AI to build useful software. You enjoy learning through experimentation, working with others and turning ideas into practical solutions in a fast\-moving environment.

**Experience**

* Practical experience using AI development tools to build or prototype solutions; this may come from professional experience, personal projects or independent experimentation.
* Good understanding of software engineering principles and experience working with code.
* Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or similar.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and AI\-enabled software development workflows.
* Evidence of having built or delivered something practical, with an interest in progressing prototypes towards production.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to engage with business and technology colleagues.


Experience with some of the following would be useful; we do not expect candidates to have experience across all areas:

* Java, Python, C\#, TypeScript or similar languages
* AWS, Azure or GCP
* Docker and Kubernetes
* Git\-based development workflows
* REST APIs and event\-driven architectures
* Test automation and Infrastructure as Code
* Observability and monitoring tools


Experience in Asset Management, Investment Management or Financial Services is desirable but not essential.

**Personal Attributes**

* Curious, creative and enthusiastic about experimenting with AI.
* Strong aptitude and willingness to learn new technologies quickly.
* Pragmatic and comfortable learning from approaches that do not work.
* Collaborative, adaptable and comfortable working across business and technology teams.
* Delivery\-focused and motivated by turning ideas into useful outcomes.
* Comfortable working with some ambiguity while seeking guidance when needed.

**Behavioural Expectations**

**Brave**

* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.

**Bold**

* Set clear, outcome\-led direction and make decisive trade\-offs.
* Simplify processes and governance where possible.
* Empower teams through effective decision making.

**Curious**

* Drive continuous prioritisation based on outcomes, data and evidence.
* Challenge assumptions and encourage innovative thinking.
* Use delivery metrics and business outcomes to inform decision making.

**Compassionate**

* Act as a visible advocate for client and business outcomes.
* Foster collaboration, trust and psychological safety.
* Balance delivery pace with sustainable ways of working.

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.


For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

We're looking for a **DevEx Engineer** to join our **Empower platform squad "Taycan"**. The squad is split between our HQ in Vejle and our Copenhagen office, so the role can be based in either location.



The Taycan squad helps engineers spend more time delivering product value and less time solving the same technical problems. We build shared capabilities that make the preferred engineering path easier to use.



As our new **DevEx Engineer**, you'll work on the shared tooling, libraries and development patterns used by engineering squads across AutoProff. From scaffolding and shared libraries to patterns such as Outbox, Sagas and messaging, you'll help make software development simpler and more consistent – so our product squads can spend less time solving the same technical problems and more time building great products.



You'll work closely with platform engineers, service owners and engineers across our product squads, building solutions that are used across the engineering organisation rather than within just one product area.



Help build shared capabilities and DevEx foundations that enable teams to work effectively with agentic AI.



Use agentic AI in your own DevEx work and share practical learning with engineering teams.



We foster a developer\-friendly culture with room to explore new technologies and ways of working. You'll have access to modern AI\-powered tools, join hackathons and take part in internal developer forums where we share ideas and discuss architecture, technology and engineering challenges.


**Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will**


* Build and evolve shared libraries, scaffolding templates, and CI/CD tooling that remove recurring friction for product squads.
* Build paved paths for messaging patterns like Outbox and Sagas, observability, and rehydration/recovery tooling.
* Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, and AWS infrastructure.

* Help squads adopt platform practices that make service ownership, operation, and reuse easier.

* Hands\-on experience building shared libraries, observability tooling, and reusable APIs.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to support squads, gather feedback, and drive adoption.


**The nice\-to\-have skills**


* Experience in platform engineering or developer enablement roles.
* Familiarity with internal documentation practices, onboarding tooling, and automated scaffolding.
* Hands\-on work with service event rehydration, incident recovery tooling, or metadata standards.
* Practical experience using LLMs, generative AI, or agentic AI in software development.


We're eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don't wait, apply today!

At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used\-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.



We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.


With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

jobs.title: Erfaren AI Harness Engineer – vær med til at forme agentic udvikling hos Danske Spil
jobs.description:
Som Senior AI Harness Engineer bliver du en del af teamet, der bygger fundamentet for Danske Spils AI\-first udviklingspraksis. Du træder ikke ind i et færdigt setup – du er med til at definere det.


Du får en hands\-on og teknisk rolle med stort mandat. Sammen med teamet designer du, hvordan vi evaluerer agenter, måler kvalitet og sikkerhed, bygger integrationer og afgør, hvornår teams og opgaver er klar til agentic udvikling.

**Velkommen til AI Harness\-teamet**


Teamet ligger i IT Udvikling og refererer til Chef for Platform \& Core Services. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med IT\-ledelsen og udviklingsteams på tværs af organisationen. Vores mål er at skabe et fælles harness, som gør agentic udvikling anvendelig, målbar og holdbar i praksis.


Vi arbejder spec\-drevet ud fra et enkelt princip: Agenter har autonomi mellem gates – aldrig hen over dem. Mennesker godkender specs og pull requests, og du er med til at bygge de gates, der gør modellen robust. Teamet er nysgerrigt, teknisk stærkt, pragmatisk, vidensdelende og retningssættende.

**Din rolle**


Du bygger selv, men din effekt stopper ikke ved den kode, du leverer. Du udfordrer tekniske valg, etablerer standarder og gør løsningerne brugbare for de teams, der skal arbejde med dem. Det sker gennem kode og værktøjer – og gennem håndbog, workshops og løbende sparring.

**Dine vigtigste ansvarsområder**

* **Evals og agent quality:** Designe og bygge evals, der gør kvalitet, robusthed og sikkerhed målbar på tværs af agenter, skills, tools og modeller.
* **Observability og forståelse:** Bygge telemetri og dashboards for brug, performance, fejlmønstre, omkostninger og kvalitetsmetrikker – blandt andet opdelt på kode\-proveniens – samt udvikle gode reviewmønstre for agent\-skrevet kode.
* **Readiness og quality gates:** Definere, hvornår teams, kodebaser og opgaver er klar til agentic udvikling, herunder om en agent kan bygge, køre tests og få deterministisk feedback.
* **Tools, agents og skills:** Designe og udvikle CLI’er, MCP\-integrationer, custom agents og agent skills, der fungerer i udviklernes reelle arbejdsgange.
* **Onboarding og teknisk retning:** Rulle det fælles harness ud på tværs af .NET\-, Java\- og appteams og omsætte nye modeller, tools og patterns til løsninger, der skaber værdi i praksis.

 **Vores tekniske landskab**


Vi arbejder blandt andet med GitHub Copilot, GitHub, Atlassian, Datadog, Grafana, Kubernetes og ArgoCD. Udviklingsteams bruger blandt andet .NET, Java, Go, TypeScript/React samt Kotlin, Swift og React Native på mobil. Harness, evals og dashboards bygger vi selv.


Du behøver ikke kende hele vores stack fra dag ét. Det afgørende er din tekniske tyngde, din kritiske sans og din nysgerrighed på, hvor agentic udvikling stadig kan gå galt.

**Vi forestiller os, at du**

* **Har stærk software\- og platform engineering\-erfaring:** Du har eksempelvis arbejdet som Senior Software Engineer, Platform Engineer eller AI Engineer og kan omsætte komplekse behov til robuste løsninger.
* **Har praktisk erfaring med AI\-agenter:** Du har arbejdet hands\-on med MCP, agentic workflows, evals, prompts, context engineering eller beslægtede discipliner.
* **Tænker test, kvalitet og sikkerhed ind fra begyndelsen:** Du kan skelne evidens fra hype, læser gerne både changelogs og forskning og forholder dig kritisk til resultater og risici.
* **Bygger gode værktøjer og arbejdsgange for udviklere:** Du har blik for developer experience og for, hvordan standarder og gates bliver en hjælp i hverdagen.
* **Kommunikerer stærkt og deler din viden:** Du trives i tæt samarbejde med teams og kan gøre tekniske valg forståelige og anvendelige i kode, dokumentation, workshops og samtaler.

**Hvorfor Danske Spil?**


Fordi du får mulighed for at bygge noget, der endnu ikke er færdigdefineret – og få reel indflydelse på, hvordan AI\-agenter bliver en del af softwareudviklingen på tværs af en stor organisation. Du får både lov til at gå dybt teknisk og skabe effekt langt ud over dit eget team.

**Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?**


Vi læser ansøgninger igennem løbende, men deadline for at søge er den 4\. oktober 2026\. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Lars Ottesen på lao@danskespil.dk. Hvis du har spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Business Partner, Mette Overgaard Holm på MEHO@danskespil.dk.

jobs.title: Digital Technology Student Workers - Software Engineering
jobs.description:
This autumn semester , we are excited to welcome **four** new student workers to join our teams in Billund. These roles span across front\-end and full\-stack software engineering, offering great opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.


**Student Worker,** **Brick** **L** **ink** **Technology (role 1\)**

As our Student Worker – Frontend Development, you'll build real frontend features on BrickLink.com alongside engineers who are rebuilding the platform on a modern stack. You'll join a product team with engineering, product, and design partners, and your work will reach a live global audience. You'll experience both a long\-running production system and a greenfield modern architecture while contributing to member\-facing experiences across home pages, accounts, sessions, and community touchpoints within the LEGO® ecosystem.


**Required Qualifications**

* JavaScript or TypeScript fundamentals
* Experience with/exposure to React (or a comparable component framework)
* Experience with/exposure to HTML and CSS \- semantic markup, responsive layout
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with/exposure to Next.js or a modern SSR framework
* Basic experience with backend/APIs or testing
**What** **you'll** **build**

* Frontend features that improve the experience for BrickLink members.
* Pages aligned with LEGO design and component systems.
* Solutions that help legacy and modern platforms work together during replatforming .
* Experiences that meet quality, performance, and accessibility expectations at scale.
* Visible improvements that reach members while helping the team modernise the platform.
**Student Worker, Brick Technology (role 2\)**

As our Student Worker \- Frontend Engineer, you'll work in the Digital Element Design area, helping migrate web applications to the LEGO® design system. You'll refactor and replace user interface components, apply design tokens and styles, and help ensure the applications remain responsive and accessible. Working in a TypeScript and React monorepo , you'll contribute to modernising the design ecosystem one component at a time while collaborating closely with designers and engineers.


**Required Qualifications**

* Studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
* Exposure to or experience with React, TypeScript, and CSS through university, personal, or other projects
* Fluent English
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Applied basic unit testing practices and validated changes using existing test suites
* Explored web accessibility and responsive design principles through projects or coursework
**What** **you'll** **build**

* Migrate web applications to the LEGO design system
* Refactor and replace existing user interface components
* Apply design tokens and styling standards across applications
* Help ensure a responsive and accessible user experience
* Contribute to the modernisation of a shared frontend ecosystem used across the team
**Student Worker, Cybersecurity Platforms (role 3\)**

As our Student Worker, Software Engineer, Cybersecurity, you'll work across a wide range of cybersecurity platforms, applications, and engineering challenges. You'll help implement software features, build infrastructure through code, and support large\-scale security logging solutions. Some of the tools and platforms you'll work with are bought and maintained , while others are built from scratch by the team. You won't be expected to know everything from day one. Instead, you'll learn alongside experienced engineers while contributing to meaningful work from week one.


**Required Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing studies in computer science or a related field
* Exposure to software development through university projects, hobby projects, internships, or similar practical experience
* Fluent English
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with C\# or Next.js
**What** **you'll** **build**

* Implement new features across cybersecurity platforms and applications
* Help build and maintain infrastructure through code
* Support the operation of large security logging solutions
* Contribute to both internally developed and vendor\-supported security technologies
* Learn new technologies and engineering approaches while supporting the team
**Student Worker, Manufacturing Technology (role 4\)**

As our Student Worker, you'll join the Warehousing and Site Logistics product team within Manufacturing Technology. You'll help build and support software solutions used in warehouses, logistics operations, and material handling across manufacturing sites. You'll contribute as a regular member of the team while learning both technical and business\-domain topics. The role offers the chance to work on systems with real operational impact, where reliable software helps keep production moving every day.


**Required Qualifications**

* Exposure to or experience working with Typescript, React, and Go
* Fluent English
* Studying computer science, software engineering, or related subject
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to or experience with Python
**What** **you'll** **build**

* Support software solutions used in warehousing, logistics , and material\-handling operations
* Contribute to development activities that support factories and warehouses globally
* Work alongside experienced engineers on technology decisions and software delivery
* Help improve systems that support continuous movement of products through the supply chain
* Contribute to initiatives connected to factory expansion and new\-site implementation projects
**We're** **looking for students who**

* Are currently enrolled in Denmark in a **Bachelor’s, Master’s, or** **Erhvervsakademi** (professional academy) program in fields related to data.
* Preferably graduating summer 2028 or beyond, having at least 1\.5\-2 years left of studies
* Are curious and willing to learn, with a **positive, team\-player attitude** .
* Can be present 15–20 hours per week, ideally with 1–2 days at our **LEGO** **office** **in Billund** .
* Are passionate about digital technology and eager to contribute to real projects.
If you're interested in joining us, please prepare your CV and cover letter in English. We also ask that you in your CV or cover letter indicate which role you’re most interested in.


The application portal will remain open from 14 th September to 12 th October 2026, but it may be taken down earlier so we urge you to apply as soon as possible. If you are shortlisted, you will be invited to attend our Assessment Day on 4 th November 2026 at our Kornmarken Campus in Billund. Following the Assessment Day, there will be one final interview round. The expected start date for successful candidates is either 1 st December 2026 or 1 st January 2027\.


\#LI\-MF2


Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.


**What’s in it for you?**

Here is what you can expect:


**Family Care Leave** \- We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.


**Insurances** – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.


**Wellbeing** \- We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.


**Colleague Discount** – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.


**Bonus** \- We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.


**Workplace** \- When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.


Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.


The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.


The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.


Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.


Just imagine building your dream career.


Then make it real.


**Join the LEGO® team today.**

jobs.title: Cloud Developer - CID
jobs.description:
**Experienced Cloud Developer**


Brænder du for cloud\-arkitektur, integrationer og moderne udviklingsprincipper – og motiveres du af at bygge robuste, skalerbare løsninger tæt på forretningen?
  

Så har vi en spændende mulighed i Kvik A/S, hvor du bliver en central, spiller i vores Cloud Integration \& Development (CID) team.


Måske arbejder du i dag som udvikler og er klar til at tage næste skridt i din karriere?
  

Som Cloud Developer i Kvik A/S, tilbyder vi netop denne mulighed.


**Om teamet (CID)**


CID\-teamet driver en moderne Microsoft cloud platform i Kvik og er med til at sikre stabile og løbende forbedrede digitale services til vores butikker og interne teams.
  

Vi arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi og bygger integrationer og API\-services, der binder vores forretningssystemer sammen.


Vi arbejder tæt sammen med bl.a. BizApps (Power Platform/Dynamics 365\), ERP (D365 Business Central), Data (MS DWH/Fabric) og Digital Marketing – og vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, samarbejde og en kultur med højt til loftet.
  

Det er derfor vigtigt at du ikke kun bringer stærke tekniske kompetencer ind i rollen, men også meget gerne en solid forretningsforståelse, og helt sikkert en vilje til at lære.


**Om stillingen**


Som Cloud Developer får du et bredt ansvar, hvor du både sætter teknisk retning, skaber overblik og omsætter arkitektur til virkelighed. Du bliver en nøgleperson i arbejdet med at udvikle og vedligeholde vores cloud‑principper, patterns\- og standarder – og du hjælper teams og stakeholders med at træffe de rigtige tekniske valg.


Samtidig er du hands\-on udvikler og deltager aktivt i design og implementering af C\#/.NET baserede løsninger i Azure, herunder API’er, integrations\-flows og eventdrevne komponenter baseret på messaging og asynkrone mønstre.
  

  

Du arbejder især med de forretningskritiske og komplekse dele af platformen, hvor robusthed, skalerbarhed og driftssikkerhed er afgørende.
  

**Dine primære ansvarsområder**


* **Cloud‑strategi og arkitektur:** Udvikle og vedligeholde skalerbare cloud‑arkitekturprincipper og standarder (primært Microsoft\-teknologi).
* **Thought leadership:** Være et fagligt fyrtårn og bidrage til retning, kompetencesikring og best practices i CID’s virke.
* **Governance \& compliance:** Sikre overholdelse af sikkerhed, lovgivning og interne retningslinjer i cloud‑miljøer.
* **Innovation og optimering:** Identificere nye teknologier og metoder, der skaber forretningsværdi og reducerer omkostninger.
* **Samarbejde og rådgivning:** Arbejde tæt sammen med udviklingsteams, arkitekter og stakeholders for at sikre helhedsorienterede løsninger – og proaktivt drive integrations‑ (og evt. AI\-) initiativer.
* **Automatisering og drift:** Drive automatisering, DevOps\-principper og Infrastructure as Code.
* **CI/CD og platform:** Vedligeholde og videreudvikle CI/CD\-processer og tekniske processer på tværs af vores services.
* **AI, udvikling og anvendelse**  

Det forventes at du har erfaring med AI i tooling, anvendelse og kvalitetssikring.
  

Det vil være en fordel med erfaring fra AI udviklingsprojekter, men ikke et krav.

**Teknologier og værktøjer**


Vores stack er Microsoft \- centreret og inkluderer typisk:


* Azure (Cloud development, Functions, integrationer, Service Bus, API Management, Redis Cache)
* Cloud Architecture / platform design
* Azure DevOps / CI/CD
* .NET / C\# og API design
* Power Platform / Dynamics 365 (tæt samarbejde og integrationsflader)
* Github Enterprise

**Din profil**


Vi forestiller os, at du:


* Har solid erfaring med Azure og cloud arkitektur i praksis (gerne integrations\-/platformfokus)
* Har solid erfaring med C\# / .NET
* Har erfaring med API’er, integrationer og event‑baserede patterns
* Har stærk forståelse for DevOps, CI/CD, automatisering og IaC
* Kan kombinere arkitektur og rådgivning med evnen til at få ting til at ske i praksis
* Trives i et tværgående setup med mange stakeholders og kan kommunikere klart – også på engelsk
* Taler flydende dansk og kommunikerer ubesværet på engelsk i skrift og tale
* Tager end\-to‑\-end ansvar for løsninger ud fra et “you build it, you own it”‑ princip, fra ‑C\#kode‑ og arkitekturvalg til drift, overvågning og løbende forbedringer

**Du tilbydes**


* Mulighed for at arbejde i hjertet af et forretningskritisk applikations\- og integrationslandskab
* Indflydelse og ansvar i et selvstyrende team med fokus på samarbejde og trivsel
* En international virksomhed i vækst med spændende digitaliseringsinitiativer
* Tæt sparring med erfarne kolleger og mulighed for at præge Kvik’s cloud og integrationsrejse

With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

* Engineering

**Front\-End \& Web**

*As a Tender Engineer at Sarens, you prepare technical\-commercial proposals for heavy lifting and specialized transport projects worldwide. You analyse client requests, coordinate input from engineering and support departments, and translate all this into clear, competitive offers. You work closely with Sales and Project teams to find the best balance between safety, budget, scope and timing. In this role, you help our clients and our organisation rise to every challenge in line with our motto: Nothing Too Heavy, Nothing Too High.*  

  

**Join the force behind \#NOTHING TOO HEAVY, NOTHING TOO HIGH**


Due to a large number of opportunities, we are looking for a driven Sales Coordinator / Tender Specialist to strengthen the Sarens Projects team. In this role, you aim to  

provide clients with a structured, solution\-oriented, and clear proposal within the  

agreed timeline. In collaboration with the Key Account Manager, you clarify the proposal and respondto the client's questions.  

Your future responsibilities as a Tender Specialist include:  

  

**Your future responsibilities in a nutshell:**  

* You analyse and summarise client requests and tender documents, identifying technical, commercial and planning requirements.
* You develop technical\-commercial proposals for heavy lifting and engineered transport projects together with the responsible Key Account Manager or Sales Manager.
* You coordinate input from internal stakeholders (Engineering, Logistics, HR, SHEQ, Finance, etc.) and guard deadlines to submit complete, structured and high\-quality offers.
* You prepare cost calculations, support pricing decisions and review them together with the Sales Support Manager and/or management.
* You ensure that all proposals are submitted on time, in line with internal approvals, and you follow up questions or clarifications with the client in coordination with Sales.
* You act as a proud Sarens ambassador, providing professional support to our global Sales and Projects organisation.
* You report to the **Sales Support Manager** and work from **Sarens HQ, Wolvertem**, in close collaboration with the wider Sales Support and Project teams.


\-
**ABOUT YOU**


We are looking for a **stress\-resistant multitasker** with a **hands\-on mentality**, s**trong writing skills, and a solution\-focused, positive attitude.** You have a strong interest in the world of specialized transport and heavy lifting. jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description:
**Mission**
-----------


The Professor Courtine's laboratory at EPFL is offering a position for a Test Engineer to work on the development of neurorehabilitation therapies for patients with motor disabilities (spinal cord injury).


Our mission is to conceive and deploy innovative interventions to restore motor functions after central nervous system disorders, especially spinal cord injury, and to translate our findings into clinical applications capable of improving the quality of life for people with motor impairments.


Please visit the .NeuroRestore website www.neurorestore.swiss to learn more about our mission.


**Main duties and responsibilities**
------------------------------------


* Supporting .NeuroRestore researchers and clinicians at CHUV by verifying and validating robust software that contributes to various stages of therapy development (including: imagery, therapy optimisation, interface with the electrical stimulators, home use)
* Ensuring medical grade software quality following industry best practices for patients' usage at home and for researchers in rehabilitation facilities
* Designing, coding, and driving the automation of test suites across the software stack
* Building and improving a hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test bench for systems interfacing with sensors and spinal cord stimulators
* Defining and executing test strategies (unit, integration, system, regression) with a strong emphasis on traceability and reproducibility
* Providing remote as well as on site support to researchers, clinicians and patients in using those tools and systems
* Contributing to release testing, verification \& validation documentation, and quality records in line with IEC 62304 or related standards
* Working closely with software engineers to identify risks early and ensure meticulous, high\-quality deliverables
**Profile**
-----------


* Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, from an accredited institution (or equivalent qualification)
* 2 years of experience working as a test/software engineer, or equivalent experience
* Comfortable writing code and building automated test frameworks (preferred languages: C\#, Python, C, Rust)
* Knowledge of IEC 62304 or related software lifecycle/quality standards
* Experience with hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing and interfacing with sensors/hardware
* Good knowledge of software architectural patterns
* Extra meticulous, detail\-oriented, and committed to quality deliverables
* Excellent team\-working and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent project and time management skills combined with strong demonstrated organizational skills
* Excellent oral and written communication
* Fluent in English. French and German are a plus.
  

It would be a plus to have:
* Experience in regulated industries (medical, automotive, spatial, etc.)
* Good knowledge of clinical trial documentation
* Familiarity with test management tools and requirements traceability systems
**We offer**
------------


The qualified candidate will benefit from joining a dynamic and multidisciplinary group working at the interface of neurorehabilitation science, regulatory, medical science, engineering and prosthetics. They will collaborate with EPFL academic labs, CHUV clinicians and vibrant medical high\-tech companies. The candidate will have the opportunity to work at the interface between academia, industry, and the clinic with collaborators from different backgrounds and cultures, including worldwide scientific experts in rehabilitation and neurotechnology.

jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


AMER


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Department**
--------------


Operations


**Compensation**
----------------


* Tier 1$130K – $165K • Offers Equity

For roles based in the **United States**, the typical starting salary range for this position is listed on the job posting. In certain locations, such as the San Francisco Bay Area and the New York City Metro Area, a premium market range may apply, as listed.


These salary ranges reflect what we reasonably and in good faith believe to be the minimum and maximum pay for this role at the time of posting. The actual compensation may be higher or lower than the amounts listed, and the ranges may be subject to future adjustments.


An individual’s placement within the range will depend on various factors, including (but not limited to) education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, location, performance, and the needs of the business or organization.


If you have any questions or comments about compensation as a candidate, please get in touch with us at paytransparency@clickhouse.com.


  
**About the Team**


IT Operations at ClickHouse keeps the company's internal systems, tooling, and infrastructure running securely and efficiently — from identity and endpoint management to the platforms every team relies on to do their work. This role sits on a newly formed AI Engineering function within IT Operations, created to centralize AI Ops rather than leave it disjointed across teams. The team — a Technical Lead plus one or two AI Ops Engineers — reporting to the IT Business Systems Manager, and brings the same rigor IT Ops applies to systems and infrastructure to the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of AI solutions and the agents they power.


**About the Role**


We are looking for an AI Ops Engineer to help build and run a new AI Ops function at ClickHouse. You will work under a Technical Lead to design, build, and maintain AI\-driven solutions across the business (People, Finance, Legal, and beyond) and engineering — building integrations, maintaining agents, supporting cost visibility, and helping train the org on AI best practices. This is a hands\-on execution role: you will move quickly, ship real workflows, and help the team learn what works as we centralize AI Ops for the first time.


**Success**


This is a net\-new function; specific goals will be set with your Technical Lead. Directionally, the team is measured on:


* Measurable reduction in redundant or inefficient AI tool and model spend through right\-sizing, routing, and cost visibility
* A working framework for evaluating and selecting models/tools by cost, latency, accuracy, and risk, adopted across teams
* Agents and AI workflows built, deployed, and maintained cross\-functionally (People, Finance, Legal, Engineering, and beyond)
* Improved AI fluency and literacy org\-wide, measured through training participation, adoption of approved tools, and reduced shadow\-AI usage
* Established identity, access, audit, and lifecycle practices for AI agents that satisfy Security and GRC requirements

### **You Will**


**Build AI\-Powered Solutions**


* Develop and deploy solutions using LLMs, automation frameworks, and internal tooling, for both business and engineering use cases
* Integrate AI into existing systems (HRIS, ATS, ERP, procurement orchestration, ticketing, CI/CD, developer tooling) and legal infrastructure like CLM or Matter Management
* Build workflows such as document generation, data extraction, knowledge retrieval, and decision support across systems and knowledge bases
* Use modern integration standards (e.g., MCP) to give AI models and agents direct, secure access to internal knowledge and context

**Support Model Evaluation**


* Help test and benchmark AI models against accuracy, latency, cost, and safety criteria
* Support model risk assessments and due diligence alongside Security and GRC
* Help implement and maintain the internal model routing solution

**Support Cost Visibility**


* Help build dashboards and reporting for AI/LLM spend across teams and tools
* Implement tagging, monitoring, and alerting for cost anomalies
* Identify and execute on cost\-optimization opportunities (prompt efficiency, caching, model right\-sizing)

**Maintain Agent Infrastructure**


* Help provision, credential, and de\-provision AI agent access
* Support deployment, versioning, monitoring, and retirement of agents
* Maintain and patch agent infrastructure and dependencies
* Help maintain audit trails and logging for agent actions

**Deliver Training and Enablement**


* Design and deliver company\-wide AI training programs tailored to different audiences — non\-technical business users through engineers
* Create lightweight playbooks, guides, templates, and reusable components for safe, effective AI adoption
* Run onboarding sessions, office hours, and workshops to build AI fluency and drive adoption of approved tools and agents
* Establish a feedback loop with users to continuously improve training content, tooling, and documentation

### **You Bring**


You are not expected to have every skill below — tell us which are your strongest.


* Experience building with modern AI/ML tools and frameworks
* Experience building and consuming APIs, developing data pipelines, and architecting system integrations
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience hosting or operating services in production
* Experience comparing and evaluating AI models across providers, including trade\-offs between cost, latency, and quality
* Comfort working with usage and billing data to build cost visibility, forecasting, or optimization
* Ability to understand both business and engineering workflows and translate them into technical solutions
* Experience working with or integrating business systems as well as engineering/developer tooling
* Experience creating training materials, documentation, or workshops for mixed technical/non\-technical audiences
* Understanding of data privacy, security, and compliance considerations
* Experience implementing safeguards in AI systems, including identity and access controls for automated/non\-human actors

### **Perks**


* **Flexible work environment** \- ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote\-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
* **Healthcare** \- Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
* **Equity in the company** \- Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
* **Time off** \- Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
* **A USD$500 Home office setup** if you’re a remote employee.
* **Global Gatherings** – We believe in the power of in\-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company\-wide offsites.

### **Culture \- We All Shape It**


As part of a rapidly scaling start\-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.


Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.


### **Equal Opportunity \& Privacy**


ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.


Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

Capacidad de interlocución con usuarios de negocio y equipos técnicos.

jobs.title: Software Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.


As a Software Security Engineer, you will be actively engaged in the cutting\-edge field of software security fault analysis for state\-of\-the\-art utility meters, access points, and mesh network equipment distributed globally. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to the development of security standards within a large distributed multinational corporation.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Assist in various application security assessment activities, including white\-box and blackbox penetration testing, static code analysis, and code reviews on software products and applications.
* Assist in the implementation and integration of security measures in Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and DevOps pipelines, ensuring security is seamlessly woven into the development process.
* Communicate and collaborate with product development teams, providing necessary
* support for the secure development process and fostering a culture of security awareness.
* Research and propose efficient, practical, and applicable mitigation strategies to remediate identified security vulnerabilities.
* Collaborate in the development of tools for the automation and management of security
* assessment activities, enhancing efficiency and effectiveness.
* Travel up to 20%, based on business needs

**Requirements**
----------------

* 3 years of experience in Application Security
* Basic understanding of cryptographic key algorithms and network security.
* Basic understanding of security fundamentals and strategies: defense\-in\-depth
* methodology, C.I.A. security pillars.
* Relevant programming experience in several languages: Java, C\# .NET, ASP.NET, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Ruby, C/C\+\+.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**Desired skills**
------------------

* CISSP or equivalent Certifications.
* Familiarity with identifying and protecting against web application and web service security vulnerabilities, including those found in the OWASP Top 10 and CWE Top 25\.
* Familiarity with security testing tools for various forms of security testing, such as static analysis, dynamic analysis, software composition analysis, and penetration testing.
* Experience in scripting languages: PowerShell, Bash, Python, etc.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, IoT, and container technologies.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Opportunity to create a more resourceful world by working on the 21st century's biggest challenges: water, energy, and gas
* R\&D center with immense growth in the heart of Budapest at Deák Ferenc square
* Cutting\-edge technologies (Cloud, IoT)
* Personal development: English, soft skills, and technical training (Udemy, Pluralsight, etc.)
* Benefits: accident and life insurance, private outpatient care support, cafeteria, iPhone with a generous data allowance
* Strong culture promoting work\-life balance, remote and flexibility


Depending on your experience, this role is expected to offer between **14,000,000 HUF** and **21,400,000 HUF** annually. We review compensation regularly to stay competitive in the market.

**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**


We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast\-track your career.

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in\-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in\-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment
**What You’ll Be Part Of**


As an **AME Process Engineer**, you will play a key role in defining, developing, and implementing manufacturing processes and equipment for **acoustic products**. You will work closely with the **Industrial Project Manager**, project engineering, product development, and cross\-functional teams to ensure robust manufacturing solutions, optimal process design, cost efficiency, quality, and on\-time project execution.


In addition to your core process engineering responsibilities, you will actively support the **Industrial Project Manager in the execution of industrialization projects**, contributing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle. You will be responsible for process and equipment development, technical specifications, supplier coordination, process validation, and successful implementation of manufacturing solutions.


You will also collaborate closely with functions such as **Quality, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, and Project Management** to ensure that new and transferred acoustic products are successfully industrialized and meet the required performance, quality, cost, and timing targets.

**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Lead manufacturing process development and industrialization activities for new product introductions from concept to stable mass production.
* Design, implement, and continuously improve production processes with a focus on quality, efficiency, capacity, and operator ergonomics.
* Drive APQP deliverables, including PFMEA, Control Plans, process validation, and manufacturing documentation.
* Manage product and process changes, ensuring successful implementation while meeting customer, business, and quality requirements.
* Support feasibility studies, RFQ activities, and early project reviews to improve product manufacturability and production readiness.
* Coordinate prototype, pilot, and pre\-production builds, ensuring a smooth transition into serial production.
* Partner with global and cross\-functional teams to standardize manufacturing processes, resolve technical challenges, and promote lessons learned across projects.
**What Makes You A Strong Fit**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or another relevant technical field.
* Experience working in a manufacturing environment, preferably within the automotive industry.
* Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
* Knowledge of quality management tools and methodologies, including APQP and FMEA.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a structured and systematic approach to work.
* Ability to work independently while demonstrating flexibility, creativity, and a continuous improvement mindset.

jobs.title: Associate AI Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who Are We❓**  

*We Are Foodics!* a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.  

  

**The Job in a Nutshell**


You'll build the internal AI systems our engineers work inside every day: agents that generate and maintain tests, pipelines that triage failures before a human sees them, tooling that speeds up code review and debugging, and the evaluation infrastructure that makes our own AI features testable at all.


This is a builder's role. You'll write production code, own systems in CI, and be measured on whether engineers actually use what you ship.

**What Will You Do❓**


Test automation across the stack

* Backend: API and contract testing, service\-level and integration coverage, data setup that doesn't rot, and test design that survives a schema change.
* Frontend: web E2E and component\-level coverage with Playwright, visual and RTL regression, and suites fast enough to gate a merge rather than a nightly.
* Mobile: native and cross\-platform coverage with Appium or Maestro, device\-farm strategy, offline and sync behaviour, and the payment\-peripheral paths that only break on real hardware.
* The connective tissue: shared fixtures, environment and test\-data management, parallelisation, and CI pipelines where a red build means something.
* performance and load testing Experience.


The AI layer on top of it

* Test generation from specs, code, and production traffic — with the maintenance story solved, not just the first draft.
* Failure triage that classifies a red build before a human opens it: real bug, flake, environment, or test rot.
* Self\-healing locators and suite health tooling — flake detection, quarantine, coverage\-gap analysis.
* Evaluation infrastructure for AI features across our products: datasets, scoring, and regression detection when a prompt or model changes.
* Evaluation for our market specifically — Arabic and English behaviour, RTL interfaces, and region\-specific POS, tax, and payment rules. Correctness here is rarely a string match.


Agentic AI and orchestration

* Agentic AI that does real work in our pipelines: reads a diff, runs the relevant suite, reproduces a failure, proposes a fix, opens the PR.
* Agents that own a quality workflow end to end — exploratory testing against a running build, coverage\-gap hunting, release\-risk assessment — and know when to escalate to a human.
* Orchestration that holds up under load — multi\-step planning, tool use, retries, state and memory across steps, sandboxed execution, multi\-agent handoffs, and clean boundaries between agentic and deterministic steps.
* Integration with the stack we already have (CI, Jira, observability, MCP\-style tool interfaces) rather than a parallel system beside it.
* The judgement to know when a plain pipeline beats an agent, and to say so.


The technical ground
You should be current on how this work is actually done today, and able to argue about it rather than recite it:

* Test automation: framework design and layering, the test pyramid and where it stops being useful, flake economics, parallel execution, mobile and cross\-browser realities, CI/CD gating, Framework: Playwright, Appium, Maestro
* Agentic AI: orchestration and tool use, multi\-step planning, memory and state, sandboxed execution, multi\-agent patterns, MCP and similar tool\-integration standards, and the cost of each.
* Context engineering: retrieval strategy, chunking, reranking, caching, and managing long\-context behaviour — including where it degrades.
* Evaluation: offline and online evals, LLM\-as\-judge and its failure modes, human\-in\-the\-loop review, statistical significance on small samples, regression gates in CI.
* Reliability: structured output, guardrails, fallback and retry design, and handling non\-determinism in systems that must not flap.
* Operations: tracing and observability for LLM systems, prompt and version management, latency and cost budgeting, model routing, and when fine\-tuning or distillation beats a better prompt.

**What Are We Looking For❓**

* An engineer who ships production software, with recent hands\-on work on LLM\-backed systems that real users depend on.
* Strong Python; comfortable in at least one of .NET, Java, or TypeScript. Tested, maintained code — not notebooks.
* Real automation depth across more than one surface. You've owned a suite that gates releases on backend and on a UI — web or mobile — and you can explain how you kept it green without deleting the hard tests.
* Real experience building evaluation systems. You can explain how you knew your system was getting better, with numbers.
* Practical depth with the modern LLM toolkit — prompting, structured output, tool use, retrieval, agentic AI orchestration — and a clear sense of the trade\-offs.
* Credible testing fundamentals. You don't need a QA title, but test design, automation frameworks, and CI/CD shouldn't be new to you.
* A bias toward adoption. You measure your work by what other engineers use, not by what you demoed.

**What We Offer You❗**  

We believe you will love working at Foodics!

* We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in\-office, and hybrid work setups.
* We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
* We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper\-growth environment.
* Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
* We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.
